{{Quote|These things aren't native to this planet; they're a laboratory hybrid from an Ithorian root-source, genetically enhanced for a zero-moisture environment.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]|<ref name="SS">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>}}
'''[[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] root-source''' was an organic specimen used in laboratory conditions as a genetic basis for creating [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrids]] capable of surviving in zero-moisture environments.<ref name="SS" /> The resulting organisms were named [[Ithorian crawler]]s and were later deployed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during a [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|punitive operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gholondreine-β]].<ref name="SS" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="EU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref>
